name: What kind of gas shutoff valves are there?

mainEntity.name: What kind of gas shutoff valves are there?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are primarily two common types of gas shutoff valves used in residential settings: ball valves and stopcock valves. Ball valves use a rotating ball with a hole through it to control gas flow, known for their quick quarter-turn operation and durability. Stopcock valves, often older, use a tapered plug. Both serve the same purpose, but modern installations typically favor ball valves due to their reliability and ease of use. A professional can help determine the best type for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common gas shutoff valve types are ball valves, known for quick operation, and older stopcock valves. Ball valves are generally favored for modern installations.
